bankImport.intro: Download your transaction history as a CSV file from your bank’s website and choose it here. You will review every row before anything is saved.
bankImport.accountHint: Imported transactions are saved as completed in this account.
bankImport.privacy: The file is read only on this device: it is not sent anywhere. Maximum 2 MB and {max} rows.
bankImport.error.tooLarge: The file is too large (maximum 2 MB).
bankImport.error.notCsv: No columns were found in the file.
bankImport.error.help: Make sure you choose a CSV file (text separated by commas or semicolons), not a PDF or an Excel sheet.
bankImport.step2: 2. Tell us what each column is
bankImport.mapIntro: Clara tried to recognize the columns. Check that the date, description and amount are right.
bankImport.hasHeader: The first row has the column names
bankImport.dateAmbiguous: The dates in the file fit both day/month and month/day. Check a date you know.
bankImport.dateMismatch: Some dates are not valid with this format.
bankImport.invertHint: Use it if your bank shows expenses as positive.
bankImport.invertCardHint: Many cards show purchases as positive and payments as negative. Check it if your purchases appear as income.
bankImport.expenseCategory: Expense category when no rule matches
bankImport.incomeCategory: Income category when no rule matches
bankImport.categoryNote: Category rules suggest each row’s category from its description; you can change it row by row. Payments to your card will arrive as expenses: you can turn them into transfers afterwards.
bankImport.duplicateNote: Rows imported before cannot be imported again, so importing the same file twice creates no duplicates.
bankImport.beforeAnchorNote: Transactions before your reference balance ({date}) are saved as history and do not change the balance, because it already includes them.
bankImport.sameDay: Transactions on {date} were already included in the balance you entered
bankImport.sameDayHint: That is the day of your reference balance. If you entered it after they happened, leave this checked so they are not subtracted twice.
bankImport.failed: Nothing was imported: some rows are not valid
bankImport.trashedNote: Rows whose transaction is in the trash are not imported again: if you want it back, restore it from the trash.
bankImport.purgedNote: Some rows were imported before and you permanently deleted their transaction. They are unchecked: check them only if you want to record them again.
bankImport.currencyColumnHint: If the file has a currency code on each row, Clara compares it with the budget’s.
bankImport.fileCurrencyHint: This budget uses {currency}. If the file is in another currency it is not imported: Clara never converts.
bankImport.currencyNote: {count} rows are in another currency and cannot be imported: this budget uses {currency} and Clara does not convert.
bankImport.balanceEffect: Account “{account}” in {currency}: the balance will change by {effect} ({count} after the reference balance; earlier ones stay as history).
bankImport.cardPaymentNote_one: {count} row looks like a card payment and is left unchecked. A card payment is neither an expense nor an income: the purchase was already the expense. Record it as a transfer between your accounts (“+” tab › Transfer) so it is not counted twice.
bankImport.cardPaymentNote_other: {count} rows look like card payments and are left unchecked. A card payment is neither an expense nor an income: the purchase was already the expense. Record them as transfers between your accounts (“+” tab › Transfer) so they are not counted twice.
bankImport.scheduleMatch: Looks like the scheduled payment “{name}” due {date}
bankImport.linkSchedule: Link to “{name}”: the calendar will mark it paid
bankImport.referenceColumnHint: A unique transaction number per row. With it, two identical transactions on the same day aren’t confused and re-importing an overlapping statement duplicates nothing.
bankImport.tooManyRowsHelp: Split the file and import the rest later: what’s already imported will be recognized as a duplicate.
bankImport.omittedAck_one: I understand that {count} row of the file is left out of this import
bankImport.omittedAck_other: I understand that {count} rows of the file are left out of this import
bankImport.omittedAfter_one: {count} row of the file was left out
bankImport.omittedAfter_other: {count} rows of the file were left out
bankImport.tooManyRows: The file has {total} rows and Clara reviews at most {max} at a time: rows {from} to {to} ({omitted}) aren’t shown and won’t be imported.
bankImport.possibleNote: Possible duplicates match the amount and type of a transaction you entered by hand (3 days apart or less) or of one imported before on the same day whose description starts the same way. They are unchecked: check them only if they are different transactions.
bankImport.error.row.currencyConflict: Two different currencies ({found} and {other}); this budget uses {expected}
